how_to_resume: 1. cd to the scratchpad or any temp dir; the three drivers are reproducible from this file alone.

3. CVAA: for each local repo D, node cvaa/inoculate.mjs <GH>/D --json --no-write. ALWAYS --no-write (cvaa is not your lane; without it the run writes vaccines/last-fired.json). The JSON is ONE line among log lines - select the line containing '"schema"'.
4. Gates: see the gates map below; three of them take arguments and silently 'fail' without them.
5. Crosslink: re-extract edges and diff against crosslink.json.
6. Diff heads{} below against git rev-parse HEAD; report only moves.
7. Commit ONLY claude/sessions/202609030120-cicd-spider by explicit path. Never git add -A.
